unconstrainedReason: fast_float exposes only pure functions (from_chars / from_chars_advanced overloads, integer_times_pow10, the chars_format bit operators and from_chars_result_t::operator bool). Every call is independent of every other; there are no objects, handles or ordering requirements, so there is no caller-legality rule to state. The harness still decodes the record stream so sequences of parses with different formats run in one input.
